Storylane build notes

WatchTower voice demo: steps and timestamps

The voice-over recording runs the ClosedAI swarm story from normal work to a zone cut, then shows how Equinix AI Engine judges it. Each step below gives the frame to capture, where to put the hotspot, and the tooltip text, in story order.

File docs/watchtower-demo-lily-voice-trim.mp4Length 3:35With voice-overFull screen, switching between ClosedAI Agent Swarm, Agent Watchtower and Equinix AI Engine

How the story escalates

Tier 0 · watchOne odd write. WatchTower flags it and blocks nothing.
Tier 1 · one agentRepeated: that agent's key is revoked automatically.
Tier 2 · departmentSeveral agents in one team: a person confirms revoking the team's keys.
Tier 3 · enterpriseAcross teams and outside the company: a person confirms cutting the Fabric VCs; AI Engine judges it.

Timestamps are from the recording's own clock, to the nearest second. The steps are in story order, so the AI Engine timestamps are not in sequence. Voice-over times come from a machine transcript and can be off by a second or two. The key revocations and Fabric VC cuts in this demo are simulated; the agents, model calls and AI Engine analysis are live.
